messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: public access to lavaan:::computeDelta() output
parts:
Hi Yves,

Is the output of the hidden function lavaan:::computeDelta() publicly available as one of the options for lavInspect()?  It doesn't seem to be, but I might be missing something.  To implement a Two-Stage ML function in semTools, I need the matrix of model derivatives, with nrow == number of sample moments and ncol == number of estimated parameters (as seen in equation 6 here: http://dx.doi.org/10.1080/10705510903008238 ).  I could always just "borrow" that syntax from the lavaan source code, but perhaps I could calculate it from other lavInspect() output? 

Thanks for your help,

Terry
